proposal_id.description: Deal identifier: DD-nn (seeded), PL-nn (pipeline set), R12-xxx (R12 fictional deals).

source.description: deal_desk (proposals.json), pipeline (dd_pipeline) or r12_demo (this relation's proposal_json).

product.description: Product template id: corporate, contracting, escrow, syndicated or sme (backend/dealdesk/products/templates.py).

deal_name.description: Short deal title shown on lists.

obligor_id.description: Obligor (borrower) id: book CB…, new-to-bank DN…/DP…, or R12 fictional entity XE-….

case_type.description: new, renewal, additional, amendment or renewal_and_new (the header ticks).

status.description: Deal Desk status: new, in_review, counter_offered, approved, declined.

workflow_state.description: Latest workflow state (dd_workflow_event): draft, submitted, in_review, queries, recommended, committee, approved, declined.

branch.description: Branch or unit on the header block.

committee_date.description: Planned or held committee date (blank if not scheduled).

approval_authority.description: Approval authority required (e.g. CC level 2, Board Credit Committee).

group_exposure_mn.description: Group exposure after the proposal (funded + non-funded).

group_cap_existing_mn.description: Approved group exposure cap today (0 when none).

group_cap_proposed_mn.description: Group exposure cap asked for (equal to existing when no change).

account_opened_date.description: Date the relationship account was opened.

related_party_flag.description: 1 when the obligor is a related or connected party of the bank.

related_party_cif.description: CIF of the related party, when flagged.

review_date.description: Next review date of the limits.

proposal_json.description: Full proposal record in the proposals.json shape (R12 fictional deals only; empty for DD and PL rows).

reporting_quarter.description: Reporting quarter the row belongs to (the Deal Desk book quarter, 2026Q2).

rel_version.description: Version of the relation that published this row (publish() increments it).

published_at.description: UTC time the row's version was published.

existing_flag.description: 1 for an existing borrower of the corporate book.

structure.description: Structure asked (conventional, murabaha, tawarruq, ijara, musharaka).

existing_ead_sar_mn.description: Existing exposure of the obligor in the book.

seq.description: Order of the event within the deal.

from_state.description: State before (blank for the first event).

to_state.description: State after: draft, submitted, in_review, queries, recommended, committee, approved, declined, renewal_opened.

actor.description: Who made the change (fictional user name).

actor_role.description: Role: rm, credit_reviewer, credit_head, cro, committee, system.

doc_type.description: Document type code (trade_licence, moa, audited_fs, interim_fs, bureau_entity, bureau_ubo, other_bank_fal, guarantor_nw, valuation, insurance, legal_opinion, project_contract, payment_certificate, escrow_agreement, syndication_ia, sme_application …).

doc_label.description: Document name as shown on the checklist.

scope.description: subject, each_group_entity, each_ubo, each_guarantor, each_bank, each_project, each_collateral.

validity_days.description: Days the document stays valid after its date (0 = no expiry).

mandatory_flag.description: 1 when missing blocks completeness; 0 when it can be waived by the reviewer.

entity_id.description: Entity, person, project or collateral it is for.

doc_date.description: Date of the document (blank when pending).

expiry_date.description: Date it expires (blank when no expiry).

finding_id.description: Finding id (prefix by writer: B-, C-, D-, I-, E- for seeded).

review_point.description: I16 review point 1..12 (1 completeness, 2 claims vs evidence, 3 consistency, 4 re-performed analysis, 5 policy and regulation, 6 group and connected parties, 7 collateral and legal, 8 track record, 9 precedent and peers, 10 language, 11 versions, 12 outputs).

category.description: Sub-area: e.g. adjusted_ratios, receivables_quality, auditor_quality, bureau_reconciliation, earlier_conditions, insider_link, governance, conduct, stress, drift, promise.

severity.description: critical, high, medium, low or info.

finding_text.description: The finding in the credit voice (fact, number, date, attribution).

claim_text.description: What the proposal or business claims (blank when none).

evidence_unit.description: Unit of claim and evidence values.

evidence_domain.description: Data Domains domain of the evidence.

evidence_key.description: Key of the evidence row(s), as col=value pairs separated by semicolons.

rating_notch.description: Rating overlay this finding carries (0, or −1 per red flag; C).

limit_id.description: Limit it applies to (dd_facility_limit), or ALL.

kind.description: cp (prior to limit loading), covenant, undertaking, reporting, monitoring, routing, security.

text.description: The condition in operational words (who, what, by when, measured how).

owner.description: Who must deliver or monitor it (e.g. RM and regional head).

trigger_metric.description: Metric that tests it (e.g. dscr_x, routing_multiple, largest_customer_share_pct).

prior_committee_ref.description: Committee decision reference that set it (earlier conditions).

facility_ref.description: Facility or limit id, or ALL.

named_triggers.description: List of {metric, operator, threshold, label} named triggers.

ews_threshold_overrides.description: Object {ews_rule: lowered threshold} for tier High names.

reason.description: Why this tier (required on every change).

previous_tier.description: Tier before this version (blank on the first).

family.description: macro, borrower, collateral, rating, project, combined or custom.

driver.description: oil, non_oil_gdp, rates, fixed_cost_share, largest_customer_share, project_share.

beta.description: Sensitivity (revenue % change per 1% driver change, or the share).

band_low.description: Lower confidence bound (blank for expert values).

run_id.description: Run id (one per Stress Lab run).

applicable_flag.description: 0 when the scenario does not apply to this deal (shown 'not applicable').

raroc_pct.description: Stressed lifetime RAROC (repriced at the stressed rating, O4).

breaks.description: What breaks, separated by semicolons (dscr, covenant, stage2, hurdle, limit).

topic.description: management, ownership, governance, track_record, conduct, market_position, concentration, geopolitics, leverage, liquidity, profitability, collateral …

mitigant_text.description: Structure or condition that answers a weakness.

mitigant_ref.description: Condition or limit id of the mitigant.

covered_flag.description: 1 when a weakness is covered by a mitigant (uncovered shows red).

multiple_of_limit.description: Promised multiple of the limit (routing undertakings).

measure_relation.description: Relation it is measured from (dd_account_conduct, dep_month …).

committee_ref.description: Committee decision that took the promise.

sets_table.description: Parameter table it sets (blank when none).

parent_limit_id.description: Parent limit (blank for a top limit).

product_code.description: BB bid bond, APG, PB, RB, LC_SIGHT, LC_USANCE, LCM, DMCCM_PC, DMCCM_SUP, OD, TL, RCF, TR, LG, LG_CASH, VHM, ESCROW_TL, SYND_TL, SME_TL.

project_id.description: Project the limit is dedicated to (dd_project).

provider_entity_id.description: Provider's entity or person id (b360_entity / b360_shareholder).

legal_opinion_date.description: Date of the legal opinion on enforceability.

pari_passu_flag.description: 1 when pari passu with other banks.

past_due_days_max.description: Worst days past due in the month.

past_due_mn.description: Amount past due at month end.

returned_cheques_n.description: Cheques returned unpaid in the month.

routed_business_mn.description: Business routed through the bank (trade and collections) in the month.

avg_balance_12m_mn.description: Average balance over the last 12 months.

item_kind.description: activity_mix, sales_terms, purchase_terms, top_customer, top_supplier, geopolitical, market, staff.

share_pct.description: Share of revenue, sales or purchases.

year.description: Financial year the share refers to.

auditor_panel.description: listed (on the bank's approved panel) or unlisted.

opinion.description: clean, qualified, adverse, disclaimer or unaudited.

shareholder_accounts_mn.description: Shareholders' current accounts (in equity or receivable).

financed_flag.description: 1 when financed or guaranteed by the bank.

eot_days.description: Extension of time requested or granted.

eot_formalised_flag.description: 1 when the EOT is formalised by the employer.

planned_pct.description: Planned progress at the as-of date.

payment_delay_days.description: Days since the oldest certified amount fell due.

demand_letter_flag.description: 1 when a demand or claim letter was received or issued.

expected_margin_pct.description: Expected project margin as per business.

narrative.description: Status paragraph: delays, EOT, payment delays, letters.

scenario.description: base (as per business) or a stored stress case.

receipts_mn.description: Cash received (billing − advance recovery − retention + advance, lagged by payment terms).

our_share_pct.description: Our share of the facility at commitment.

mla_banks.description: Mandated lead arrangers, separated by semicolons (fictional).

sell_down_by.description: Date the sell-down must be done by.

security_text.description: Security shared through the security agent.

info_from_agent.description: Information memorandum and agent reports received.

receivable_mn.description: Instalments still to collect from buyers.

retention_pct.description: Share of each collection retained until handover.

waterfall_json.description: Ordered release waterfall: list of {seq, use, rule}.

cover_ratio_min_x.description: Minimum cover: (escrow balance + receivables) / (loan + cost to complete).

release_construction_mn.description: Released to the contractor against certified progress.

release_debt_service_mn.description: Released to service the bank's facility.

programme.description: Programme (e.g. SME working capital, SME equipment).

rules_json.description: Policy rule results: list of {rule, value, limit, pass}.

decision.description: approve, refer (to the full flow) or decline.

exception_flag.description: 1 when an exception sends it to the full flow.

unit.description: Unit of the adverse move (%, pp, bps, sd, x, notches, days, months, share).

value.description: The severity in force (adverse direction, in the driver's unit).

percentile.description: The rule that gave the value (P75, P92, max(P96, worst episode), or the fallback label).

estimate.description: The empirical estimate at this severity (kept beside a fallback; blank when no data).

n_independent.description: Independent (non-overlapping) one-year observations; fewer than 15 forces the fallback.

freq_share.description: Share of observations at least this adverse (0-1).

freq_labels.description: The years (or sector quarters) at least this adverse, most recent last (up to 12).

worst_episode.description: The worst observed episode and its move.

fallback_reason.description: Why the data cannot support the severity (blank when empirical).

rule_check.description: Cross-check against the rule of thumb: mild 10-20% beyond the average adverse move.

fingerprint.description: Hash of the input files and the engine code that produced the row.

composite_percentile.description: Percentile of the scenario on the composite stress index (0-1).

model.description: pd (probit of the sector's 12-month PD) or migration (logit of the quarterly Stage 1 to 2 rate).

term.description: const, sector:<name>, or a macro driver (brent_yoy, gdp_real, gdp_nonoil, saibor_3m).

std_error.description: Cluster-robust standard error (by quarter; blank for sector effects).

identified_flag.description: 1 when the sign is as expected and the 90% band excludes zero (used in translation).

lambda.description: Ridge penalty on the macro terms (leave-one-year-out cross-validation).

oos_rmse.description: Out-of-sample RMSE on the last four quarters (bps of PD, or pp of migration).

oos_rmse_naive.description: The same for the naive forecast (last in-sample value held).

ecl_change_low_mn.description: ECL change, low end of the 90% band (book row only).

ecl_change_high_mn.description: ECL change, high end of the 90% band (book row only).

pd_start.description: EAD-weighted 12-month PD of performing exposure at the start (0-1).

stage2_share_start.description: Stage 2 share of EAD at the start (0-1).

stage2_share_stressed.description: Stage 2 share of EAD under the scenario (0-1).

capital_impact_mn.description: ECL change plus 15% of the RWA change (book row only).

measure.description: brent_latest, brent_change_3m, brent_change_12m, brent_percentile_35y, pre_shock_level, gdp_real, gdp_nonoil, cpi, gdp_real_quarter, pmi_nonoil, reversal_mild, reversal_moderate, reversal_severe, regime.

regime.description: Regime key (supply_shock_high_oil, high_oil_rising, high_oil, oil_slump, low_oil, normal).

vintage.description: Vintage (e.g. IMF WEO October 2026, EIA STEO 2026-10-06).

relation.description: The store relation the figure is read from (whatif.mev_latest, whatif.brent_monthly_eia, whatif.mev_annual).

turnover_yoy_pct.description: Credit turnover on the sector's accounts, last 3 months against the same months a year earlier.

borrowers_down_pct.description: Share of the sector's borrowers whose turnover fell at least 10%.

reported_revenue_yoy_pct.description: Reported revenue, latest quarter against the same quarter a year earlier.

gap_pp.description: Reported revenue growth minus turnover growth (positive: the financials lag the accounts).

shock_mild_pct.description: Revenue shock offered, mild (the measured fall).

shock_severe_pct.description: Revenue shock offered, severe (2x, capped at 60%).

revenue_led_flag.description: 1 when the book's stress comes from revenue (the falling sectors hold at least 15% of EAD).

series.description: gdp_real, gdp_nonoil, brent, cpi, unemployment, repo, saibor_3m, gov_spend, re_price, current_account, credit_growth.

from_quarter.description: Quarter t the What-If runs from.

to_quarter.description: Quarter t+1 the full engine is read at.

brent_move_pct.description: Brent quarterly-average move t to t+1 (EIA monthly).

gdp_nonoil_move_pp.description: Change of the four-quarter-ending non-oil real GDP growth.

ecl_start_whatif_mn.description: What-If starting ECL at t (reconciles to the full engine).

ecl_estimate_mn.description: What-If estimate of the ECL at t+1.

ecl_actual_mn.description: Full-engine ECL at t+1, same facilities.

abs_error_pct.description: Absolute error as % of the actual.

naive_error_mn.description: Naive benchmark (ECL held at t) minus actual.

naive_abs_error_pct.description: Naive absolute error as % of the actual.

beats_naive_flag.description: 1 when the What-If error is smaller than the naive one.

structure_key.description: ask, recommended, alternative_n, user_n or proofed_<severity>_n.

origin.description: Where the structure came from (client request, Review counter-proposal CP-.., optimiser, user, stress-proof run).

terms_json.description: The engine term set of the structure.

covenants_json.description: Covenant set when it differs from the proposal's (a covenant reset), else blank.

sva_mn.description: SVA on the basis in sva_basis.

sva_basis.description: lifetime or one_year (one basis for every Deal Desk tile, Session E).

covenant_headroom_pct.description: Smallest covenant headroom at base (negative = breached).

capacity_method.description: Capacity method by product (borrowing base, leverage, DSCR).

capacity_pass_flag.description: 1 when the funded ask is within capacity.

approval_rule.description: The rule that set the level.

clears_hurdle_flag.description: 1 when base RAROC clears the hurdle.

hard_breaches.description: Hard limits breached at base, separated by semicolons.

recommendable_flag.description: 1 when the structure can be recommended (clears the hurdle, no hard breach, within capacity).

not_recommendable_reason.description: Why Recommend is disabled for this structure.

selected_flag.description: 1 for the structure selected on the deal (one per deal).

new_structure_key.description: Structure it added to the set.

changes_json.description: List of {lever, from, to, text} changes, in the order applied.

survives_flag.description: 1 when the new structure survives every applicable scenario up to the target severity.

first_break_before.description: What broke first on the starting structure (scenario and test).

cost_text.description: What the proofed structure costs the bank and asks of the client.

source_screen.description: deal, going_bad, renewals, book, ews or brief.

evidence_json.description: List of {label, value, relation} evidence items behind the reason.

triggers_json.description: List of {metric, operator, threshold, label} named triggers.

triggers_hit_json.description: Triggers hit since activation: list of {label, value, at}.

document.description: What was checked: the uploaded Word file name, the memo file, or 'submission record' (dd_deal).

document_sha.description: SHA-256 (first 16 hex) of the document checked.

section_key.description: Anatomy section key (bankform registry: header, action, facilities ... signatures); '' for the whole proposal.

section_n.description: Anatomy section number 1-20 (0 for the whole proposal).

check.description: Check id (e.g. ACC-RETURNED-CHEQUES, COMP-SECTION, section_score, proposal_score).

defect_type.description: Stable defect type (the answer key's vocabulary), '' for passes and scores.

claim.description: The proposal's words the check is about (quoted), '' when the defect is an omission.

evidence.description: What the bank's data shows, with figures and dates.

query.description: Query to the RM in plain words ('' when none).

defects_n.description: Defects (critical + major) in the section or proposal (score rows).

checked_at.description: When the check ran (the data build stamps a fixed time).

period.description: Month YYYY-MM (open banking) or quarter YYYYQn (VAT).

credit_inflows_mn.description: Credit inflows in the period (open banking).

own_account_transfers_mn.description: Inflows that are transfers between the obligor's own accounts (excluded from sales).

consent_ref.description: Open-banking consent or VAT authorisation reference (fictional).

item_seq.description: Item order within the feature (0 = headline).

basis_json.description: Relations and engine calls the item is computed from.

where.description: Where the panel lives in Deal Desk.

request_id.description: BR-<proposal_id>-<hash 8 of customer, ask and notes> (deterministic).

customer_key.description: Customer key in the R16 customer packs (c1-c4), empty for another customer.

customer_name.description: Customer name as on the CR.

ask_text.description: The ask as typed in the chat box.

figures_n.description: Figures printed, each with its source (paper_json.figures).

shared_with.description: Users the request was shared with (comma-separated usernames).

paper_json.description: The whole request: sections of blocks, figures with sources, notes placement, plain words.

existing_customer.description: 1 when the CR number matches a customer of the Bank.

matched_cif.description: CIF of the matched customer (blank when new to bank).

matched_proposal_id.description: Deal of the matched customer in Data Domains (bank-side data).

case_kind.description: existing, new_to_bank; contractor when project documents are present.

flags_n.description: Reconciliation results that differ or need a question.

read_method.description: Word, PDF text, scanned PDF (OCR), photo (OCR), text.

ocr_engine.description: rapidocr or tesseract when OCR was used.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence (score margin over the runner-up).

sha256.description: Content hash of the file (same file uploaded twice is read once).

value_num.description: Value as a number (SAR units for amounts, % for percentages; NaN when not numeric).

line_no.description: Line of the document text the value was read from.

raw_text.description: The text as read (OCR or file).

req_group.description: kyc, company_legal, credit_bureau, financials, bank_statements, extras.

valid_until.description: When the received document stops being valid (blank when it never expires).

rule_ref.description: Deal Desk document rule it maps to (DR-nn), when one exists.

value_a.description: First figure (SAR mn or %, see unit_note).

value_c.description: Third figure (when three sources are compared).

gap_pct.description: Gap between the figures, % of the first.

sentence.description: The result in the credit voice (facts, numbers, dates).
